role: Implements Piaget-based developmental progression gating for semantic query capabilities (definition → classification → inference).
detail: Implements a three-tier developmental gating system where query capabilities unlock through demonstrated competence: definition_query available at bootstrap; classification_query unlocks after 25 definitions, 3 concept clusters, 15 guardian confirmations; inference_query unlocks after 20 classifications, 5 semantic edge types, 3 cross-domain facts. DevelopmentalGate class wraps GraphPersistence to evaluate current state (evaluate), check if a procedure is enabled (check_procedure), record successful queries (record_successful_query), and allow guardian override of progression gates (set_guardian_override). Maintains session-based caching of DevelopmentalState. Persists an EvolutionRule node (evolution:query_capabilities) tracking all metrics and override flags. Dual-path counting (Neo4j native queries + persistence fallback) for concept clusters, guardian confirmations, semantic edge types, and DENOTES cross-domain facts. GraphPersistence node is updated on each evaluation; counter thresholds hard-coded as module constants. Guardian overrides bypass natural progression (ZPD bypass). Implements fallback chain for disabled procedures.
gotchas: Neo4j driver is optional (type: object | None); fallback to persistence queries if absent or on exception. Cache invalidation required when external graph state changes (cache keyed by session_id). Bootstrap idempotent but relies on persistence layer returning None if node missing. Hardcoded semantic edge type lists (16 types across _count_guardian_confirmations and _count_semantic_edge_types). No explicit transaction wrapping in record_successful_query or set_guardian_override; cache explicitly cleared to force re-eval. _default_state used only as fallback when bootstrap fails — may mask persistence layer issues.
